heading: Funds available for workers compensation payments

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Available balances of expired Library of Congress appropriations shall be available to the Library of Congress to make the deposit to the credit of the Employees’ Compensation Fund required by subsection 8147(b) of title 5.

tree.heading: Effective date
tree.text: This section shall apply with respect to appropriations for fiscal year 2012 and each fiscal year thereafter.

notes.text: Codification Section is from the Legislative Branch Appropriations Act, 2012, which is div. G of the Consolidated Appropriations Act, 2012.
